text: O03.1 is complete at docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.1/receipt.json; implement ADR004 PREPARE-before-local-commit, durable remote COMMIT before success, unresolved-intent closed recovery, nonce/current-head and epoch fencing. F02.2 reserves event/head/certificate fields but only permits LocalOnly and null certificates; a later additive migration must introduce actual witness states and keys. Legacy snapshot recovery is fenced for organization catalogs. Restore must preserve the complete authority history, not infer currency from this local genesis/hash chain.
